cohort.name: legacy_builder_catalogue
cohort.generator: products.builder (Design: motif, palette, width, repeat) + creative.emotional_brief (recipient, occasion, moment, function)
cohort.why: the legacy Build-1 catalogue; concept-tournament output is a separate cohort and is not counted here

problems: HELD: title promises a village; the snowfall motif depicts snowflakes only (proposed: 'Winter Snowfall Graphghan')

brief.moment: A maker counts down to a friend's due date, working one lattice repeat each evening so the blanket is folded and ready for the first visit home.
brief.function: wraps the baby for the first visits home, then stays folded at the foot of the cot as the first thing made for them
brief.gifting: Given to the new parents at the shower or on the first visit home, made by a friend or grandparent rather than bought.
sensory: raised diamond lattice ridges under the fingertips
quiet cream and ink contrast suited to a nursery
brief.handmade_life: Turns the long wait for a baby into evenings of making something the family will keep.
brief.laura_scene: Laura folding the finished blanket over a nursery chair in morning window light; the blanket is the subject.
brief.premise: A raised diamond lattice in cream and ink that small fingers can trace across the whole blanket.

problems: HELD: title promises oak; the fir-and-star motif depicts firs and stars (proposed: 'Fir and Star Mosaic Throw')

brief.moment: The morning of the harvest dinner the runner comes out of the linen drawer, and the long table finally starts to look like the holiday.
brief.function: dresses the family table for the one dinner a year when everybody sits down together
sensory: wine and gold chevron band running under the serving dishes
firm flat stitch fabric that lies straight along the table
brief.handmade_life: A piece made once and brought out every autumn, so the holiday table carries the maker's own work.
brief.laura_scene: Laura laying the runner along a set harvest table before guests arrive; product-first, Laura's hands in frame.
brief.premise: A marching chevron band in wine and gold runs the full length of the harvest table under the serving dishes.

brief.moment: Two people eat their first dinner in a new home on a box-strewn kitchen table, and the one finished thing in the room is a laid table for two.
brief.function: sets two places for the first dinner in a new home before the boxes are unpacked
brief.gifting: Brought to a housewarming in place of a bottle, so the first meal in the new kitchen has a laid table.
sensory: diamond lattice texture under the plate rim
cream and wine pairing that reads as a matched set
brief.handmade_life: A small, finishable make that marks a new home with something made rather than bought.
brief.laura_scene: Two placemats set on a bare wooden table with mismatched new-home crockery; Laura optional, setting the second place.
brief.premise: A matched diamond lattice pair in cream and wine sets two places at a small kitchen table.

problems: HELD: title promises stars; the snowfall motif depicts snowflakes (proposed: 'Nordic Snowflake Ornament Set (6)')

brief.moment: On the first of October the children help hang the pumpkin flags across the front window, and the countdown to trick-or-treat night begins.
brief.function: turns the front window into a countdown to trick-or-treat night for the children of the house
brief.gifting: Made with or for the children of the house, hung on the first of October and packed away on the first of November for next year.
sensory: round pumpkin row flags swinging along the window frame
warm wine and gold colours against the dark October glass
brief.handmade_life: A family ritual the maker can repeat every autumn, with flags small enough to finish in an evening.
brief.laura_scene: Laura and a child's hands pinning the garland across a window at dusk; the garland reads first.
brief.premise: A string of pumpkin row flags in wine and gold swings across the front window for the whole of October.

brief.moment: The garland goes up across the bedroom doorway the night before, so the first thing a partner sees on Valentine's morning is a row of hearts.
brief.function: says what a card says but stays strung across the doorway for the whole of February
brief.gifting: Hung before a partner wakes on Valentine's morning, a surprise that took several quiet evenings to make.
sensory: solid heart row shapes swinging in a doorway draught
cream and wine colour pairing that reads from across the room
brief.handmade_life: A love note that is made rather than bought, and kept for next year instead of thrown away.
brief.laura_scene: Laura stringing the garland across a sunlit bedroom doorway; hearts in sharp focus, Laura soft behind.
brief.premise: A row of solid hearts in cream and wine is strung across the bedroom doorway for Valentine's morning.

brief.moment: A rescue dog comes home in December, and the first evening there is already a mat by the fire that is unmistakably theirs.
brief.function: gives a pet a warm spot of its own beside the family on long winter evenings
brief.gifting: Made for a friend bringing home a new dog or cat, so the new arrival has a place that is already theirs.
sensory: dense basketweave blocks with a firm padded hand
pine and gold colours that hide paw prints between washes
brief.handmade_life: Making for the whole household, animals included, is part of a handmade home.
brief.laura_scene: A dog asleep on the mat by a hearth, Laura reading in the chair behind; the mat is the subject.
brief.premise: A dense basketweave mat in pine and gold marks out the dog's own spot beside the fire.

problems: HELD: title promises flowers; the heart-row motif depicts hearts (proposed: 'Heart Appliqué Motif Library (12)')
HELD: title promises botanical imagery; the chevron-band motif depicts chevrons (proposed: 'Cottage Chevron Wall Hanging')
